comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
I got this one from the fleet just north of danzig. They have fairly low crew but they're pretty fast. I used a rowing galley with about 60 crew on them and no offensive gear. I was ambushed by this fleet consistently there, got it I think on the 3rd fleet I fought.

I'm using this drop to augment my collection toward the "fake vikings" event. :)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Good thinking. Here's an excellent plunder guide to anyone else who wants to find a specific MA armor for the Viking event:

uwomarcos.blogspot.com/2014/08/plundering-rare-items-mannequinsviking.html

And remember, to get all the armor-related rewards, you must give the Lady Buccaneer NPC nine named MA viking armors. However, duplicates won't work in my experience; if you give her a Erik the Red's armour and then find another one later, she won't accept it towards the x9 armor total for the sail reward. Guess that would've been too easy, eh? Well, there's a few days left. Cheers, and good hunting.
